cause: Pi normalizes file:// patterns to local paths before minimatch and exact matching. PiSharp previously left URI text in the glob and exact-pattern paths.
fix: LocalResourcePathRules.NormalizePattern converts local and localhost file URIs to local paths; LocalResourcePathRulesTests.FileUrlPatternsNormalizeBeforeGlobAndExactOverrideMatching covers glob exclusion, force inclusion and final force exclusion.
evidence: Raw failing report was captured in the local ignored artifacts before the fix; the compact observations here are retained for CI. The post-fix frozen differential report is generated at artifacts/parity/resource-glob/glob.json.
